description:
Look up a token on Base, Ethereum (ERC-20 contract) or Solana (SPL mint): name, symbol, decimals and total supply, plus mint and freeze authority on Solana, read live from the chain. Use it to confirm what an address actually is before acting on it.

$0.002 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote.

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.

token.description: ERC-20 contract, or SPL mint on Solana.

name: token_info
title: Token info
